problem: Every harvest two or three of our 40 stainless fermentation tanks get stuck: sugar stops dropping for days and we only notice at the morning density check. We log tank temperature every 10 minutes and density twice a day, but nobody looks at the curves together. We want an early warning, ideally 24 hours before a fermentation stalls, that our cellar master can trust and act on.
